description_en: Modifies the Anti-DDoS scrubbing threshold for a single asset with a public IP address
description_zh: 修改单个公网IP资产的DDoS防护清洗阈值
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public modify-defense-threshold --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --instance-id i-uf6idy3c57psf7vu0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDefenseThreshold

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset that is assigned a public IP address.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html to query all region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the asset that is assigned a public IP address. Valid values:

ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

slb: Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

eip: Elastic IP Address (EIP) instance.

ipv6: IPv6 Gateway instance.

swas: simple application server instance.

waf: dedicated Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

ga_basic: basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh:
公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

ecs：表示云服务器ECS实例。
slb：表示负载均衡SLB实例。
eip：表示弹性公网IP实例。
ipv6：表示IPv6网关公网实例。
swas：表示轻量服务器公网实例。
waf：表示Web应用防火墙独享实例。
ga_basic：表示全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the asset that is assigned a public IP address.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354191.html to query the IDs of the ECS, SLB, and EIP instances that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
公网IP资产的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354191.html查询当前阿里云账号拥有的ECS、SLB、EIP实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The scrubbing threshold for traffic in Mbps. This value cannot exceed the peak public network traffic of the instance. If you specify Bps, you must also specify Pps. Otherwise, the change does not take effect.

Use the monitoring tools of your instance to query its public network traffic:

For an ECS instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25482.html.

For an SLB instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85982.html.

<props="china">

For an EIP instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85354.html.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
设置流量清洗阈值，单位：Mbps。该阈值不能超过当前实例的公网数据流量峰值。修改Bps时，Pps必填，否则不会生效。

您可以使用实例自带的监控工具，查询实例的公网数据流量：

如果您使用ECS实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25482.html。
如果您使用SLB实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85982.html。
<props="china">
如果您使用EIP实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85354.html。</props>
parameters.name: bps

parameters.help_en:
The scrubbing threshold for packets per second (pps). This value cannot exceed the peak packet traffic of the instance. If you specify Pps, you must also specify Bps. Otherwise, the change does not take effect.

Use the monitoring tools of your instance to query its packet traffic:

For an ECS instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25482.html.

For an SLB instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85982.html.

<props="china">

For an EIP instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85354.html.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
设置报文数量清洗阈值，单位：pps。修改Pps时，Bps必填，否则不会生效。

该阈值不能超过当前实例的数据包流量峰值。您可以使用实例自带的监控工具，查询实例的数据包流量：

如果您使用ECS实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25482.html。
如果您使用SLB实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85982.html。
<props="china">
如果您使用EIP实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85354.html。</props>
parameters.name: pps

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically adjust the scrubbing threshold based on the traffic loads of the instance. Valid values:

true: The scrubbing threshold is automatically adjusted. You do not need to set the Bps and Pps parameters.

false: The scrubbing threshold is not automatically adjusted. You must set the Bps and Pps parameters.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用自动设置，即根据实例的流量负载，自动调整清洗阈值。取值：
true：表示是，无需手动设置Bps、Pps参数。
false：表示否，需要手动设置Bps、Pps参数。

默认值：false
parameters.name: is_auto

parameters.help_en: The public IP address of the asset
parameters.name: internet_ip

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, generated by Alibaba Cloud. You can use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
